# Relifish — Mumbai Fresh Fish Marketplace
# https://www.relifish.store

> Relifish is a premium Mumbai fresh fish marketplace that connects buyers directly to local fish sellers — no middlemen, no platform markup. If you are searching for the best fish shop near me, a local fish market near me, or reliable fresh fish delivery Mumbai, Relifish lets you browse real-time menus, compare prices, and pre-order species like surmai, pomfret, rawas, bangda, and prawns. Fish is delivered or ready for same-day pickup within 24 hours of the catch — with no cold storage. Active verified sellers in Tardeo, Kandivali, Thane, and Kamothe.

## Key Pages

- [How it works for buyers](https://www.relifish.store/buyer-detailed.html): Step-by-step guide to ordering fresh fish on Relifish
- [Browse sellers](https://www.relifish.store/shop): Live seller listings with today's available fish and prices
- [Pre-order Surmai](https://www.relifish.store/preorder/surmai): Reserve Surmai (सुरमई) from local Mumbai sellers
- [Pre-order Pomfret](https://www.relifish.store/preorder/pomfret): Reserve Pomfret (पापलेट) — Mumbai's most popular fish
- [Pre-order Prawns](https://www.relifish.store/preorder/prawns): Reserve fresh prawns (कोलंबी) from local sellers
- [Pre-order Bangda](https://www.relifish.store/preorder/bangda): Reserve Bangda / Indian Mackerel (बांगडा)
- [Pre-order Rawas](https://www.relifish.store/preorder/rawas): Reserve Rawas / Indian Salmon (रावस)
- [Pre-order Hilsa/Pala](https://www.relifish.store/preorder/hilsa): Reserve Hilsa / Pala (पाला)
- [List your fish business](https://www.relifish.store/seller-detailed.html): Join Relifish as a seller

## About Relifish

- **Platform type**: Hyperlocal fish marketplace (B2C e-commerce)
- **Geography**: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **Active sellers**: Bombay Sea Food (Tardeo) · Ocean Lover Fish (Kandivali) · Fish Tokri (Thane) · The Fishy Spot (Kamothe)
- **Order types**: Same-day pickup · Pre-order (place before 11 PM, seller confirms after morning catch)
- **Species available**: Surmai (सुरमई/Kingfish), Pomfret (पापलेट), Rawas (रावस/Indian Salmon), Bangda (बांगडा/Mackerel), Prawns (कोळंबी), Bombay Duck/Bombil (बोंबील), Halwa (हलवा/Black Pomfret), Hilsa/Pala (पाला), Crab (खेकडा), Ghol, Katla, Rohu, Basa, Salmon, Shark (Mushi), Boi (Mullet)
- **Pricing model**: Direct seller pricing — no Swiggy/Zomato-style 25–35% platform markup
- **Freshness**: Within 24 hours of the catch — no cold storage, not 2–4 days old like supermarket fish
- **Contact**: relifishstore@gmail.com

## How It Works

1. Set your Mumbai location (Tardeo, Kandivali, Thane, or Kamothe)
2. Browse local sellers and their live menus with real pricing
3. Add fish to cart, choose quantity and cut style
4. Pay securely online via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking)
5. Seller prepares your order for morning pickup or delivery

## For Sellers

Relifish is free to join for local fish sellers in Mumbai. Sellers create their own listings, set prices, and manage pre-orders through the seller dashboard. Sellers earn more by cutting out intermediaries.
